question: Should ClawHub add a first-class SKILL.md capability manifest for skills, and what schema, authority model, and advisory-to-required rollout should it use?
rationale: This changes the public skill trust boundary and security review contract; source inspection can show the feature is missing, but automation should not choose the permanent schema or rollout policy.

options.title: Adopt advisory manifest first
options.body: Define the capability schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and let ClawScan flag declared-vs-observed mismatches before making it required.

options.title: Defer to scanner inference
options.body: Keep using env/install metadata plus ClawScan coherence review, accepting that there is no author-declared baseline for network, filesystem, execution, or secret access yet.

options.title: Require manifests immediately
options.body: Make new submissions provide the capability block from day one, which gives a stronger contract but requires a sharper legacy and false-positive policy before rollout.

recommendation.title: Adopt advisory manifest first
recommendation.body: Define the capability schema in specs, parse and expose it as advisory metadata, and let ClawScan flag declared-vs-observed mismatches before making it required.
